overview: This episode of Medford Happenings introduced the 'Good Neighbor' series, featuring lifelong resident Rick Caraviello. The program highlighted Caraviello's decades of civic service, including his leadership in the Chamber of Commerce, his tenure on the City Council, and his role in developing the new public library and city arts center.

items.title: Introduction and Personal Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Rick Caraviello as the city's first 'Good Neighbor' guest to discuss his history as a lifelong resident and community volunteer.

items.title: Kiwanis and Chamber of Commerce Involvement
items.summary: Caraviello detailed his 33 years with the Medford Kiwanis and his 30-year history with the Chamber of Commerce, where he served as both president and executive director to keep the organization solvent.

items.title: Charitable Food Programs
items.summary: The guest described his work organizing food drives for St. Raphael's and providing holiday meals to veterans, the local women's shelter, and food banks.

items.title: Veteran Accessibility and Housing Projects
items.summary: Caraviello recounted leading collaborative volunteer efforts to install an elevator for a paralyzed World War II veteran and performing a total home makeover for a Vietnam veteran's family.

items.title: City Council Service and Mayoral Campaign
items.summary: The discussion covered Caraviello's 12 years on the Medford City Council, including three terms as president, and his experience running a clean campaign for mayor.

items.title: Medford Public Library Construction
items.summary: The guest explained how the city secured $12 million in state grants and raised $6 million in private donations to build the state-of-the-art Charlotte & William Bloomberg Medford Public Library.

items.title: Medford Art Center Development
items.summary: Caraviello described facilitating a donation of 5,000 square feet of space from a local property owner to finally establish a permanent home for the Medford arts community.

items.title: Citizen of the Year Recognition
items.summary: The program concluded with reflections on the 'Citizen of the Year' award and the importance of residents nominating deserving community members for the honor.
